content.short: Commonwealth is a platform for on-chain communities to discuss, vote, and fund projects together.
content.description: Commonwealth provides a comprehensive set of tools for DAOs to manage proposals, treasury, voting, and membership, consolidating essential functions into a single app. It helps break down silos between chat platforms such as Discord, Telegram, and Riot by offering webhooks and bridge integrations, enabling notifications wherever members prefer to receive them. Regardless of the protocol in use, Commonwealth lets DAOs participate in on-chain actions like staking and voting from within the app, centralizing core activities in one place.
